coreFindings.finding: Source files at different directory depths can legitimately carry different relative $schema paths; mergeDocuments must not treat the root $schema hint as a token metadata conflict.
coreFindings.resolution: The composed graph now keeps the first root $schema hint while preserving strict conflict behavior for semantic metadata. A regression test covers the case.
